name: MathHay
description: MathHay is an automated benchmark designed to assess the long-context mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It requires models to perform both information-seeking and complex mathematical reasoning over long contexts, highlighting challenges in current LLMs' abilities.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has seen growing interest for testing long-context mathematical reasoning, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on long-context mathematical reasoning, distinct from prior benchmarks that emphasize information retrieval.
